essays.title: After Automation
essays.note: We automated everything and kept hiring anyway: AI creates more human work, not less.

essays.title: Every's Master Plan: Part II
essays.note: Anyone can clone one of our products. Cloning the whole universe—apps, ideas, distribution—is the hard part.

essays.title: Why Generalists Own the Future
essays.note: In the age of AI, it's better to know a little about a lot than a lot about a little.

essays.title: Every's Master Plan
essays.note: Writing isn't a luxury for when business is good; it's the process the whole business runs on.

essays.title: The Knowledge Economy Is Over. Welcome to the Allocation Economy.
essays.note: Every maker becomes a manager—judged less on what you know, more on how well you allocate intelligence.

essays.title: ChatGPT and the Future of the Human Mind
essays.note: ChatGPT is a lever that becomes a lens: every task it takes over shows you what your mind is actually for.

essays.title: Admitting What Is Obvious
essays.note: You're never going to be great at something you want to want.

essays.title: What I Do When I Can't Sleep
essays.note: Taste improves when you can name it. Feed everything you love to an AI and it hands back the words you couldn't find.

essays.title: AI Is Transforming Media Forever, Here's How
essays.note: One writer with AI has the cost structure of software—and can ship what used to take a team.

essays.title: Against Explanations
essays.note: AI predicts without explaining. In fields where explanations never arrived anyway, that turns out to be enough.

essays.title: GPT-4 Is a Reasoning Engine
essays.note: GPT-4 is a reasoning engine, not a knowledge database. Its answers are only as good as the information you feed it.

essays.title: Can GPT-3 Explain My Past and Tell My Future?
essays.note: Load ten years of journals into an AI and ask it questions: you get a mirror that shows your face in new light.

essays.title: GPT-3 Is the Best Journal I've Ever Used
essays.note: A journal that talks back: no blank page, never tired of listening, awake whenever you are.

essays.title: The End of Organizing
essays.note: All that time organizing your notes was wasted. The ultimate tool for thought is tools that think.

essays.title: AI and the Age of the Individual
essays.note: Companies exist to coordinate intelligence. When intelligence gets cheap, individuals win.
